# xYang

> Parse YANG modules, validate RFC 7951 JSON instance data, and export JSON Schema.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install, CLI (`parse`, `validate`, `convert`), and library usage
- [FEATURES](FEATURES.md): YANG features implemented in xYang
- [Conformance cases](tests/cases/README.md): language-neutral cases and the Python and TypeScript runners
- [JSON Schema profile](design/json-schema-xyang-profile.md): JSON Schema (2020-12) with `x-yang`
- [xyang-model skill](skills/xyang-model/SKILL.md): author YANG modules and `.yang.json` models
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): install, CLI, validate examples, and how to run the tests
